name: codex-reconnecting-doctor
description: Diagnose and repair Codex Desktop reconnect loops, proxy drift, and WebSocket transport issues.

interface.longDescription: A safe-by-default doctor plugin for Codex Desktop reconnecting loops. It verifies local HTTP and mixed proxy ports, repairs ~/.codex/.env only when requested, checks provider transport settings, supports JSON reports, and can disable WebSocket transport for the active provider when needed.
capabilities: Verify local HTTP and mixed proxy ports
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $codex-reconnecting-doctor to diagnose why Codex Desktop is stuck reconnecting.
